title: GRADIEND: FEATURE LEARNING WITHIN NEURAL NETWORKS EXEMPLIFIED THROUGH BIASES
findings: Debiasing religious bias is substantially harder than debiasing gender bias. Most techniques show only marginal or even bias-strengthening effects. The GRADIEND method showed statistically significant improvements for religion bias in some specific models without harming language modeling performance, but its effectiveness was limited by noisy training data. The distinction between Christian and Muslim groups was found to be the most challenging for the models, likely due to greater textual and semantic overlap.
